field_guide.mapping: Defines all element types (terrain and interactive objects), where the key is a single-character representation of the element.
field_guide.terrain: Single-tile terrain layer. Each character in each row string of the grid array directly corresponds to a key in mapping
field_guide.interaction: Multi-tile interactive object layer. The anchor represents the top-left corner coordinate of the area occupied by the object, and the object extends size-specified tiles to the right (+x) and downward (+y) from that point. Includes: id (unique identifier), category (category), element (references mapping key), anchor (top-left corner coordinates {x,y}), size (occupied tiles {width,height})
field_guide.collision: Collision type for physics behavior. prevent: no collision detection or events; Passive: triggers collision events only, no physical response; Active: full collision with movement response; Fixed: immovable solid object that blocks Active bodies

X.name: space
X.description: empty area, all entities can pass through freely

B.name: brick
B.description: destructible wall, blocks player/enemy/projectile, can be destroyed by projectile

S.name: snow field
S.description: slippery terrain, player/enemy/projectile can pass through, reduces movement speed for player/enemy while on it

F.name: forest
F.description: visual cover layer, all entities can pass through, hides player/enemy beneath it visually

R.name: water
R.description: liquid terrain, blocks player/enemy movement, projectile can pass through freely

E.name: eagle
E.description: player base, must be protected, game over if destroyed by projectile, blocks player/enemy movement

P.name: player
P.description: player controlled tank, can move in four directions, fires projectile, collides with enemy/brick/steel/water/eagle

N.name: enemy
N.description: AI controlled enemy tank, moves and fires automatically, collides with player/brick/steel/water/eagle, destroyed by player projectile

X.name: space
X.description: empty passable corridor, player and ghosts can move through freely, no collision detection

B.name: wall
B.description: solid maze wall, blocks player and ghost movement permanently, defines maze pathways and boundaries

o.name: pellet
o.description: small dot collectible, player eats on contact for 10 points, eating 70 pellets spawns first fruit, eating 170 pellets spawns second fruit, all pellets must be eaten to complete level

O.name: power_pellet
O.description: large flashing energizer in maze corners, player eats on contact for 50 points, turns all ghosts blue and vulnerable for limited time, allows player to eat ghosts for bonus points (200/400/800/1600), effect duration decreases in later levels

P.name: player
P.description: pac-man character, moves through maze corridors in four directions, eats pellets and power pellets on contact, dies on ghost contact (unless ghost is blue), can eat blue ghosts for points, moves faster when not eating, turns corners faster than ghosts

G.name: ghost
G.description: enemy pursuer (Blinky/Pinky/Inky/Clyde), each has unique AI behavior and patrol corner, chases player or patrols in scatter mode, kills player on contact normally, turns blue and flees when player eats power pellet, eyes return to ghost house when eaten, moves slower in tunnels
